issues.message: Occurrence word:107:2:2 reuses teaching ID teaching:107:1:2:alladhi from word:107:1:2, but its occurrence-specific teaching payload differs in grammar, sentence role, learner connections, takeaway, and occurrence role. The assembler keys teaching entries by ID and rejects conflicting payloads.
issues.requiredAction: Assign word:107:2:2 its own stable teaching ID in both ayahs[1].words[1].teachingId and ayahs[1].words[1].layers.teaching.id, or make the two teaching payloads exactly identical and keep the contextual difference only in occurrence-specific fields; rerun assembly validation.

evidence.assemblerRule: app/data/content-production-assembler.ts mergeTeachingEntry compares entries by teaching.id and throws on a non-identical existing payload.
